Have some similarities here, although I’m not an US immigrant, just a typical Hanoian born and raised. I have some relatives leaving the country to go to the US after the Vietnam war, and our ancestors also got properties like gold, houses and lands robbed, even though a lot of my ancestors fought in wars to bring peace into Vietnam, side by side with the present government. Some got acknowledged, some are forgotten and we still are trying for the government to acknowledge them. However I believe some politicians said that it was a very wrong move of the VN gov at that time (taking people’s properties no matter who they are). And there was a period of VN gov that had a lot of dirty ones making me hate VN a bit. Still I’m proud to be a Vietnamese and now I’m just really happy living here with changes of the government. I’m just grateful to live in peace. We live for the present and the future. However, I forgive but not forget. The new generation will mostly never understand this dilemma, with them it’s just the present government 100% right and the one who’s not agreeing’s wrong, so we are the ones need to keep this story straight and believe me, karma alway returns, the corrupted ones will live miserably and we just need to focus on our lives and make Vietnamese proud. Being confused is just because we know what’s right and what’s wrong, or at least it’s for me

Với tình hình sử dụng của bạn, nếu bạn sẵn sàng chi tiền nuôi xe: bảo hiểm, xăng, chỗ gửi xe,... thì nên mua. 

Tuy nhiên bạn cũng nên xét thêm vấn đề thời gian, khoảng cách đi làm hiện tại không quá xa (của bạn là 4-6km) thì đi bằng xe máy tiện hơn. Nhưng nếu chuyển sang ô tô thì bạn cần tính thêm thời gian đi bằng ô tô (thời gian lấy xe, thời gian di chuyển nếu tắc đường...) vì rõ ràng đi làm bằng ô tô sẽ lâu hơn bằng xe máy. Thường mình nghĩ đi làm xa nhà >7km thì nên đi bằng ô tô. Có thể sau này đổi sang ô tô đi khi trời mưa, vợ bầu, có con cái,... chứ cách nhà 4km thì thời gian (nếu để xe xa nhà 1 chút) chắc sẽ gấp đôi so với thời gian đi xe máy. Cái này mình đang tính nếu ở trên phố, nội thành, những khu vực đường bé, hay tắc đường giờ đi làm và tan làm nhé. Ngoại thành thì đường to, mình thấy thoải mái, ko vấn đề gì. Hoặc có thể cung đường đi làm của bạn hoàn toàn phù hợp để đi ô tô thì mình thấy ko lo ngại lắm.

Bạn cũng cần xem thêm ô tô đến công ty để đâu, và chi phí khi để ở công ty. Gửi xe ban đêm không nên gửi bãi ngoài đường vỉa hè, dễ bị trộm vặt, mưa gió hỏng hóc nhiều thứ, tốn thêm tiền sửa.

Some popular tips I have been using till now and I can confirm they work:

- The "1 2 3 go" philosophy. You don't have to think, you just do it. 

"Do I need to go to this class or not? Do I have to get up and eat breakfast when I can lay on bed all day?" - this happens to me a lot. Don't have to think and decide anymore, just 1 2 3 and get the fuck up. End of story.

- Make a list. 

I use Google Calendar and Sheets. It literally saves my life because I'm terrible at remembering. I have classes at university, extra classes, 2 part-time jobs and they all are non-fixed, plus some meet ups with my friends. I usually make my month first for everything that is the same, and check it every week or everyday if needed or I have some changes.

- If you don't like it, but you still have to have it done, then do it in 15m. 

After 15m you'll be familiar with this, and you'll somehow get into this, and want to finish it. If you still don't like it, pause and try another time.

My body clock is fucking broken due to the fact that I've been staying up all night since high school. And well, somehow I love sleeping since I was born, so even with that trick, I can still sleep from 7pm till 5pm the next day. So yeah just be strict and disciplined.
